nodes.prompt:
TASK: Complete the daemon-side root architecture for Ferryx terminal persistence, test-first, so the daemon is the sole PTY and remote-gateway owner and GUI clients never cause fallback PTYs.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY src-tauri/src/daemon/protocol.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/server.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/client.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/mod.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/launchd.rs, src-tauri/src/terminal/output_hub.rs, src-tauri/src/terminal/service.rs, src-tauri/src/terminal/tests.rs, src-tauri/src/remote/state.rs, src-tauri/src/remote/server.rs, src-tauri/src/remote/tests.rs, plus tests inside those owned module files. First write RED tests, then implement the smallest correct changes. The current code is partially v2: protocol has version 2, Spawn(clientRequestId,cwd), Attach(afterSequence), sequenced Output, daemon epoch, and dedicated attach streams. It is incomplete in these concrete ways:
1. Daemon lacks a typed RegisterWorkspace request and currently infers/registers a "default" project from its own CWD. Add typed workspace registration with canonical repository-root validation; spawn must resolve only daemon-registered workspace/worktree identity and reject arbitrary cwd outside that registered root.
2. get_runtime_dir/run_server currently creates /tmp/rorca-{uid} and blindly unlinks daemon.sock. Add lstat/UID/mode checks: reject symlink runtime directory/socket/lock, reject foreign ownership, enforce 0700 directory and 0600 socket/lock, and remove a stale socket only after proving lock is available and ownership is safe. Internal .rorca/rorca identifiers remain compatible.
3. DaemonClient connect_or_spawn currently loops with fixed 50ms sleep/poll. Replace it with a bounded event-driven readiness path based on standalone ferryx --daemon stdout token FERRYX_DAEMON_READY (with one connection attempt after readiness); no in-process server, no silent fallback.
4. DaemonServer currently starts the remote gateway by default and GUI still has its own TerminalService-backed RemoteGatewayState. Make the daemon own remote state/listener lifecycle explicitly and expose typed protocol requests/responses plus client methods for remote status, configure enable/disable, pairing create, device list/revoke, and active selection set/get. Do not start a network listener by default. The daemon remote gateway must use its same TerminalService; remote session listing/attach/write/resize/signal must observe daemon-owned sessions.
5. Current stream lag reports a metadata-only Gap ignored by the GUI. Emit a typed replay-gap frame containing requested/available sequences plus history start/end and base64 history; on broadcast lag replay after last emitted sequence, never an unbounded full snapshot unless the gap requires it.
6. Spawn idempotency cache must be bounded by a short TTL and only return a still-live session; a repeated clientRequestId must never create a second shell.
7. Protocol mismatch must return a typed explicit error and never create an in-process PTY.
Write source-level unit tests inside your scope for every item that fail under the pre-change behavior. Do not change GUI lib/ipc/UI/integration test files or commit.
SCOPE: You own only the explicitly listed daemon, terminal, and remote module files. Do not modify files outside this list. This executable assignment does not authorize any Git operation.
VERIFY: Run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml daemon:: --lib; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml terminal:: --lib; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml remote:: --lib; cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml. All must exit 0. Report each RED command/result, GREEN command/result, every changed file, and a concise public protocol handoff table for the Tauri bridge.
STOP WHEN: The listed daemon-only ownership/security/replay contracts are implemented and tested with all four commands green, and no out-of-scope files were touched.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Complete the React persistence/reconciliation layer for daemon-backed terminal sessions, test-first, using the existing protocol-v2 UI transport surface.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY ui/src/lib/types.ts, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts, ui/src/state/workspaceRestore.ts, ui/src/state/workspaceRestore.test.tsx, ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts, ui/src/state/workspaceStore.hmrRetention.test.tsx, ui/src/App.tsx, and ui/src/App.test.tsx. The existing transport/renderer already accepts daemonEpoch and lastOutputSequence in memory, but persistence currently serializes only localSessionId/backendSessionId/cwd. First add RED tests then persist decimal-string daemonEpoch and lastOutputSequence separately from local/backend IDs; reconcile only when both daemon epoch and backendSessionId match a current daemon ListSessions result. On same epoch + live backend ID preserve local IDs, pane mappings, and attach/replay state. On epoch change or missing backend ID mark the session exited/lost without automatic respawn. HMR keeps its in-memory backend IDs, epoch, sequence, panes, and makes zero spawn/close calls. Restore coordination must still be StrictMode-safe and one disk restore at most. Do not add UI copy or a replacement UI flow; lost state is enough.
SCOPE: Own only the listed UI state/persistence/App files. Do not edit terminal transport, renderer, daemon, Tauri IPC, or unrelated UI. Do not commit or revert unrelated work.
VERIFY: Run bun run --cwd ui test -- src/App.test.tsx src/state/workspaceRestore.test.tsx src/state/workspaceStore.hmrRetention.test.tsx src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts and bun run --cwd ui build. Both must exit 0. Report RED/GREEN evidence and changed files.
STOP WHEN: Epoch-and-sequence persistence/reconciliation semantics are covered by failing-first tests and the focused suite/build are green.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Complete the Tauri GUI bridge after daemon protocol ownership is finalized: GUI must own no TerminalService, PtyManager, TerminalOutputHub, or remote terminal service.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY src-tauri/src/lib.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/terminal.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/project.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/remote.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/tests.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/blocking_contract_tests.rs, src-tauri/tests/ipc_hardening_contract.rs, and src-tauri/tests/daemon_persistence_contract.rs. First add/fix RED tests and then implement. Current source partially routes terminal IPC through DaemonClient but lib.rs still creates RemoteGatewayState with Arc<TerminalService::default()>, which violates daemon-only ownership. Use the daemon protocol/client APIs now present to proxy remote status/enable/disable/pair/device/selection operations; remove GUI RemoteGatewayState terminal ownership entirely. Preserve existing Tauri command names and client payloads. Route project registration into daemon RegisterWorkspace before spawning. Keep GUI session layout JSON persistence in ipc/session untouched. Ensure cmd_terminal_spawn/list/attach/write/resize/signal/close run only through DaemonClient; cmd_terminal_attach returns base64 history plus decimal sequence/epoch values and a gap; ensure a single replacement-safe attachment pump emits sequenced Tauri events. Update integration tests to use DaemonClient, not direct TerminalService, and replace existing fixed sleep with subscription/readiness/PTY-output bounded signals. Do not touch daemon/remote module files or UI files.
SCOPE: Own only the listed lib/ipc and integration-test files. Do not modify daemon, terminal, remote modules, UI, or any files outside scope. Do not commit/revert unrelated work.
VERIFY: Run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml ipc:: --lib; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test ipc_hardening_contract -- --test-threads=1; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test daemon_persistence_contract -- --test-threads=1; cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml. All must exit 0. Report RED/GREEN results, changed files, and exact response shapes.
STOP WHEN: GUI has no direct terminal/remote TerminalService ownership, commands proxy via daemon only, and all four verification commands pass.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement deterministic integration contracts proving the completed Ferryx terminal persistence behavior against the real standalone --daemon binary, with no desktop UI automation.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY src-tauri/tests/daemon_persistence_contract.rs and create ONLY test-local support under src-tauri/tests/ if absolutely necessary. First write RED tests that current incomplete behavior would fail. Then use an isolated per-test runtime directory/socket supplied through a supported environment/config seam; start CARGO_BIN_EXE_ferryx --daemon, await exact FERRYX_DAEMON_READY, register a temporary Git workspace using the daemon protocol, spawn two daemon-owned shells, and prove: client A disconnect leaves shell PID live; client B lists, describes, attaches, replays history exactly once, writes input, resizes; output sequences are contiguous or ReplayGap is explicit; a protocol mismatch receives an explicit error and no direct fallback; closing session A ends its process group while session B remains alive and responsive; daemon remains alive after the simulated GUI client loss. Use event/output/process-exit signals with bounded timeouts only, never fixed sleep loops. Ensure robust cleanup of daemon process, shells, sockets, and temp dirs even on failures. Also include a source-proven test that Tauri GUI process does not directly own shell children after daemon mode is active where practical.
SCOPE: Own only the specified integration test file and new test-local files. Do not edit production code, UI, or existing daemon/lib/ipc modules. Do not commit/revert unrelated work.
VERIFY: Run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test daemon_persistence_contract -- --test-threads=1 and cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --tests -- --test-threads=1. Both must exit 0. Return RED/GREEN evidence, precise artifacts/cleanup behavior, and changed files.
STOP WHEN: The real standalone daemon reconnect, replay, protocol-error, and isolated-close contracts all pass deterministically.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Independently verify the complete Ferryx terminal-session persistence implementation without modifying production source.
DELIVERABLE: Run the specified focused/full Rust and UI checks, inspect relevant final source contracts, and run a real standalone ferryx --daemon scenario exercising register -> spawn -> disconnect -> list/reconnect -> attach/replay -> write/resize -> isolated close. Persist raw human-readable evidence under .omo/evidence/terminal-session-persistence/ only: command logs plus cleanup receipt. Do not change code. The scenario must create its own isolated runtime directory/socket and terminate every process it started.
SCOPE: Read repository and write only .omo/evidence/terminal-session-persistence/. Do not edit code, tests, plans, or docs. No Git operations.
VERIFY: Execute cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --tests -- --test-threads=1; cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --tests; bun run --cwd ui test; bun run --cwd ui build. Every required command must exit 0. For the real surface scenario, prove one daemon PID, stable shell/session PID across client disconnect/reconnect, replay history plus live input, exact sequence safety or recorded gap, and isolated close. Do not report passing unless files and process cleanup receipt exist.
STOP WHEN: Return a factual verification report with each exit status, evidence file paths, observed PID/session facts, and cleanup receipt; no source files changed.
